create_torch_export: create a TorchExport instance to generate an FX GraphModule from a torch.export ExportedProgram
build_fx_graph: build an FX GraphModule from an exported PyTorch model with configurable aten or Python operator graphs
run_input_adapters: run input adapter steps to flatten, remove None, and convert complex inputs for ONNX compatibility
run_output_adapters: run output adapter steps to flatten collections and convert complex outputs for ONNX compatibility
apply_pre_export_passes: apply pre-export passes to insert explicit type promotions and analyze unsupported FX nodes
